- Werewolf: attacks one player each night from day 1 on.
- Possessed: a human who sides with the werewolf and wins when the werewolf wins; divination shows the Possessed as human.
- Villager: a human with no special ability.

The talk proceeds in days. Each day has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Jonathan, Mizuki, Rin, Misaki and Benjamin. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this day). The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

| Day | Start of the day | Talk | End of the day | Night |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Night actions
